$doc: The regression scorecard's budget (docs/design/scorecard.md), read by scripts/scorecard.mjs --compare. The rule: every row of progress/scorecard/<tag>.json is at or better than the same row of the baseline (progress/scorecard/baseline.json). `kinds` sets the noise band per row kind: a row regresses when it is worse than the baseline by more than max(rel, noise × the baseline's run-to-run spread) × baseline + abs (units: bytes for bytes / memory, ms for time / longtask / frame, fps, counts). `better` is the good direction. SSIM rows must stay ≥ min. `check: false` rows (info) print and never fail. A row the user re-budgets goes in `rebudget` as {row, max | min, why, by}: that limit replaces the baseline comparison for that row. `rules` (below) are budget rules on top: `enforced` ones fail --compare, a `proposed — awaiting Jake` one only prints.

bytes.why: transfer is near-deterministic: 1 % or 64 KiB, whichever is larger, or twice the measured spread

count.why: request counts: ±2 requests (a font or an icon racing the service worker)

time.why: time to play / switch: 10 % or twice the measured run-to-run spread, + 150 ms (the page's own 25–100 ms polls)

longtask.why: the longest main-thread task: one task, so noisier than a total

memory.why: heap after a forced GC, GPU bytes counted at the GL API: 5 % + 2 MiB

fps.why: frames per second over the pose's sample: 10 % or twice the spread

frame.why: p95 frame interval and main-thread ms per frame

drawcalls.why: draw calls / triangles at a fixed pose: creatures walking in and out of view move them

ssim.why: the look: SSIM against the golden JPEG ≥ min(0.98, the baseline run 2 vs run 1 SSIM − margin): a pose that moves on its own between two identical builds (grass in the wind, a creature walking) gets its floor from that measured noise

info.why: printed, never a verdict: whether a switch navigated / showed the loading screen, prefetch bytes

$rules: Budget rules on top of the row-by-row rule. `rows` is a row-key glob (* = one path segment); `rule`: max (an absolute ceiling, the row's unit: bytes / ms), maxFactor (≤ factor × the baseline's value), noWorse (≤ baseline + its band), improve (< baseline − its band). `status: enforced` fails --compare; any other status ("proposed — awaiting Jake") only prints. `goal` prints beside the verdict.
